title: Night aircraft spotting with Lear outside Tonopah

tellings.quote: out in the desert in the middle of the night with binoculars and stuff try- outside of Tonopah.

plain: In the 1980s, a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on unknown craft in the Nevada desert, says he went out at night with a companion named John Lear to watch for aircraft. He tells it from his own memory: they were "out in the desert in the middle of the night with binoculars and stuff" outside the small Nevada town of Tonopah, hoping to see secret or unusual flying things.
